name: intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental/AGENT.python.tools.md

intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.init_hooked_attention: initialize a QuantizedAttentionImpl submodule on an attention module for FP8 query calibration
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.attention_quant_ctx: use a context manager to prepare all attention modules for FP8 quantization calibration on a model
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.QuantizedAttentionImpl_forward: run the quantized attention forward pass that tracks query max and scale before delegating to the original implementation
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.prep_attention_module_for_calibration: prepare an attention module for calibration by registering hooked attention with the given config
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.clean_up_hooked_attention: clean up hooked attention parameters and restore the original attention implementation after calibration

intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.build_kvcache_quant_context: use the kvcache_quant_context manager to run FP8 KV cache quantization on a PyTorch model
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.create_initialize_quantized_kv_cache: initialize a quantized KV cache on an attention module with fp8_e4m3fn dtype
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.run_freeze_module_quantization: freeze module quantization by deleting observers and removing the quantized KV cache
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.test_prep_attention_module_for_calibrati: register forward pre and output hooks on an attention module for KV cache calibration
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.review_QuantizedKVParameterCache: review the singleton QuantizedKVParameterCache class that extends DynamicCache for FP8 quantized key value caching

intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.per_tensor_fp8_qdq: quantize a PyTorch tensor to FP8 format and return the quantized tensor with its scale
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.update_parameter_data: update or create a named parameter on a PyTorch module with new tensor data
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.normalize_static_kv_dtype: convert a dtype string or torch dtype to a normalized torch dtype for static KV cache
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.is_attention_module: check if a PyTorch module is an attention layer by inspecting its class name and attributes
intel_auto-round/auto_round/experimental.clean_model_parameters_and_buffers: remove specified parameters and buffers from all modules in a PyTorch model
